400	 * Name: esp32s3_getreg
401	 *
402	 * Description:
403	 *   This function may to used to intercept an monitor all register accesses.
404	 *   Clearly this is nothing you would want to do unless you are debugging
405	 *   this driver.
406	 *
407	 * Input Parameters:
408	 *   addr - The register address to read

412	 *
413	 ****************************************************************************/
414	
415	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32S3_SDMMC_REGDEBUG
416	static uint32_t __esp32s3_getreg(const char *func, uint32_t addr)
417	{
418	  static uint32_t prevaddr = 0;
419	  static uint32_t preval   = 0;
420	  static uint32_t count    = 0;
421	
422	  /* Read the value from the register */
423	
424	  uint32_t val = getreg32(addr);
425	
426	  /* Is this the same value that we read from the same register last time?
427	   * Are we polling the register?  If so, suppress some of the output.
428	   */
429	
430	  if (addr == prevaddr && val == preval)
431	    {
432	      if (count == 0xffffffff || ++count > 3)
433	        {
434	          if (count == 4)
435	            {
436	              mcerr("%s: ...\n", func);
437	            }
438	
439	          return val;
440	        }
441	    }
442	
443	  /* No this is a new address or value */
444	
445	  else
446	    {
447	      /* Did we print "..." for the previous value? */
448	
449	      if (count > 3)
450	        {
451	          /* Yes.. then show how many times the value repeated */
452	
453	          mcerr("%s: [repeats %d more times]\n", func, count - 3);
454	        }
455	
456	      /* Save the new address, value, and count */
457	
458	      prevaddr = addr;
459	      preval   = val;
460	      count    = 1;
461	    }
462	
463	  /* Show the register value read */
464	
465	  mcerr("%s: %08x->%08x\n", func, addr, val);
466	  return val;
467	}

502	 *
503	 * Description:
504	 *   Function to send command to Card interface unit (CIU)
505	 *
506	 * Input Parameters:
507	 *   cmd - The command to be executed
508	 *   arg - The argument to use with the command.
509	 *

512	 *
513	 ****************************************************************************/

515	static int esp32s3_ciu_sendcmd(uint32_t cmd, uint32_t arg)
516	{
517	  clock_t watchtime;
518	
519	  watchtime = clock_systime_ticks();
520	
521	  while ((esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_CMD) & SDMMC_CMD_STARTCMD) != 0)
522	    {
523	      if (watchtime - clock_systime_ticks() > SDCARD_CMDTIMEOUT)
524	        {
525	          mcerr("TMO Timed out (%08X)\n",
526	                esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_CMD));
527	          return 1;
528	        }
529	    }

536	  esp32s3_putreg(cmd, ESP32S3_SDMMC_CMD);

581	         (unsigned long)esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS));

720	/****************************************************************************
721	 * Name: esp32s3_eventtimeout
722	 *
723	 * Description:
724	 *   The watchdog timeout setup when the event wait start has expired without
725	 *   any other waited-for event occurring.
726	 *
727	 * Input Parameters:
728	 *   arg    - The argument
729	 *
730	 * Returned Value:
731	 *   None
732	 *
733	 * Assumptions:
734	 *   Always called from the interrupt level with interrupts disabled.
735	 *
736	 ****************************************************************************/
737	
738	static void esp32s3_eventtimeout(wdparm_t arg)
739	{
740	  struct esp32s3_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32s3_dev_s *)arg;
741	
742	  /* There is always race conditions with timer expirations. */
743	
744	  DEBUGASSERT((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT) != 0 ||
745	              priv->wkupevent != 0);
746	
747	  /* Is a data transfer complete event expected? */
748	
749	  if ((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT) != 0)
750	    {
751	      /* Yes.. wake up any waiting threads */
752	
753	      esp32s3_endwait(priv, SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT);
754	      mcerr("Timeout: remaining: %d\n", priv->remaining);
755	    }
756	}

765	 *   priv      - An instance of the SDIO device interface
766	 *   wkupevent - The event that caused the wait to end
767	 *

778	{

781	  /* Cancel the watchdog timeout */
782

786

794	/****************************************************************************
795	 * Name: esp32s3_endtransfer
796	 *
797	 * Description:
798	 *   Terminate a transfer with the provided status.  This function is called
799	 *   only from the SDIO interrupt handler when end-of-transfer conditions
800	 *   are detected.
801	 *
802	 * Input Parameters:
803	 *   priv   - An instance of the SDIO device interface
804	 *   wkupevent - The event that caused the transfer to end
805	 *
806	 * Returned Value:
807	 *   None
808	 *
809	 * Assumptions:
810	 *   Always called from the interrupt level with interrupts disabled.
811	 *
812	 ****************************************************************************/
813	
814	static void esp32s3_endtransfer(struct esp32s3_dev_s *priv,
815	                                sdio_eventset_t wkupevent)
816	{
817	  mcinfo("wkupevent=%04x\n", (unsigned)wkupevent);
818	
819	  /* Disable all transfer related interrupts */
820	
821	  esp32s3_config_xfrints(priv, 0);
822	
823	  /* Clearing pending interrupt status on all transfer related interrupts */
824	
825	  esp32s3_putreg(priv->waitmask, ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS);
826	
827	  /* Mark the transfer finished */
828	
829	  priv->remaining = 0;
830	
831	  /* Is a thread wait for these data transfer complete events? */
832	
833	  if ((priv->waitevents & wkupevent) != 0)
834	    {
835	      /* Yes.. wake up any waiting threads */
836	
837	      esp32s3_endwait(priv, wkupevent);
838	    }
839	}

841	/****************************************************************************
842	 * Name: esp32s3_interrupt
843	 *
844	 * Description:
845	 *   SDIO interrupt handler
846	 *
847	 * Input Parameters:
848	 *   dev - An instance of the SDIO device interface
849	 *
850	 * Returned Value:
851	 *   None
852	 *
853	 ****************************************************************************/
854	
855	static int esp32s3_interrupt(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
856	{
857	  struct esp32s3_dev_s *priv = arg;
858	  uint32_t enabled;
859	  uint32_t pending;
860	
861	  /* Loop while there are pending interrupts.  Check the SD card status
862	   * register.  Mask out all bits that don't correspond to enabled
863	   * interrupts.  (This depends on the fact that bits are ordered
864	   * the same in both the STA and MASK register).  If there are non-zero
865	   * bits remaining, then we have work to do here.
866	   */
867	
868	  while ((enabled = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_MINTSTS)) != 0)
869	    {
870	      /* Clear pending status */
871	
872	      esp32s3_putreg(enabled, ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS);
873	
874	#ifdef CONFIG_MMCSD_HAVE_CARDDETECT
875	      /* Handle in card detection events ************************************/
876	
877	      if ((enabled & SDMMC_INT_CDET) != 0)
878	        {
879	          sdio_statset_t cdstatus;
880	
881	          /* Update card status */
882	
883	          cdstatus = priv->cdstatus;
884	          if ((esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_CDETECT) &
885	              SDMMC_CDETECT_NOTPRESENT(priv->slot)) == 0)
886	            {
887	              priv->cdstatus |= SDIO_STATUS_PRESENT;
888	
889	#ifdef CONFIG_MMCSD_HAVE_WRITEPROTECT
890	              if ((esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_WRTPRT) &
891	                  SDMMC_WRTPRT_PROTECTED(priv->slot)) != 0)
892	                {
893	                  priv->cdstatus |= SDIO_STATUS_WRPROTECTED;
894	                }
895	              else
896	#endif
897	                {
898	                  priv->cdstatus &= ~SDIO_STATUS_WRPROTECTED;
899	                }
900	            }
901	          else
902	            {
903	              priv->cdstatus &=
904	                ~(SDIO_STATUS_PRESENT | SDIO_STATUS_WRPROTECTED);
905	            }
906	
907	          mcinfo("cdstatus OLD: %02x NEW: %02x\n", cdstatus, priv->cdstatus);
908	
909	          /* Perform any requested callback if the status has changed */
910	
911	          if (cdstatus != priv->cdstatus)
912	            {
913	              esp32s3_callback(priv);
914	            }
915	        }
916	#endif
917	
918	      /* Handle data transfer events ****************************************/
919	
920	      pending = enabled & priv->xfrmask;
921	      if (pending != 0)
922	        {
923	          /* Handle data request events */
924	
925	          if ((pending & SDMMC_INT_TXDR) != 0)
926	            {
927	              uint32_t status;
928	
929	              /* Transfer data to the TX FIFO */
930	
931	              DEBUGASSERT(priv->wrdir);
932	
933	              for (status = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_STATUS);
934	                   (status & SDMMC_STATUS_FIFOFULL) == 0 &&
935	                   priv->remaining > 0;
936	                   status = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_STATUS))
937	                {
938	                  esp32s3_putreg(*priv->buffer, ESP32S3_SDMMC_DATA);
939	                  priv->buffer++;
940	                  priv->remaining -= 4;
941	                }
942	            }
943	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_INT_RXDR) != 0)
944	            {
945	              uint32_t status;
946	
947	              /* Transfer data from the RX FIFO */
948	
949	              DEBUGASSERT(!priv->wrdir);
950	
951	              for (status = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_STATUS);
952	                   (status & SDMMC_STATUS_FIFOEMPTY) == 0 &&
953	                   priv->remaining > 0;
954	                   status = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_STATUS))
955	                {
956	                  *priv->buffer = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_DATA);
957	                  priv->buffer++;
958	                  priv->remaining -= 4;
959	                }
960	            }
961	
962	          /* Check for transfer errors */
963	
964	          /* Handle data block send/receive CRC failure */
965	
966	          if ((pending & SDMMC_INT_DCRC) != 0)
967	            {
968	              /* Terminate the transfer with an error */
969	
970	              mcerr("ERROR: Data CRC failure, pending=%08x remaining: %d\n",
971	                    pending, priv->remaining);
972	
973	              esp32s3_endtransfer(priv,
974	                                  SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
975	            }
976	
977	          /* Handle data timeout error */
978	
979	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_INT_DRTO) != 0)
980	            {
981	              /* Terminate the transfer with an error */
982	
983	              mcerr("ERROR: Data timeout, pending=%08x remaining: %d\n",
984	                    pending, priv->remaining);
985	
986	              esp32s3_endtransfer(priv,
987	                                  SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT);
988	            }
989	
990	          /* Handle RX FIFO overrun error */
991	
992	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_INT_FRUN) != 0)
993	            {
994	              /* Terminate the transfer with an error */
995	
996	              mcerr("ERROR: RX FIFO overrun, pending=%08x remaining: %d\n",
997	                    pending, priv->remaining);
998	
999	              esp32s3_endtransfer(priv,
1000	                                  SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1001	            }
1002	
1003	          /* Handle TX FIFO underrun error */
1004	
1005	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_INT_FRUN) != 0)
1006	            {
1007	              /* Terminate the transfer with an error */
1008	
1009	              mcerr("ERROR: TX FIFO underrun, pending=%08x remaining: %d\n",
1010	                    pending, priv->remaining);
1011	
1012	              esp32s3_endtransfer(priv,
1013	                                  SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1014	            }
1015	
1016	          /* Handle start bit error */
1017	
1018	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_INT_SBE) != 0)
1019	            {
1020	              /* Terminate the transfer with an error */
1021	
1022	              mcerr("ERROR: Start bit, pending=%08x remaining: %d\n",
1023	                    pending, priv->remaining);
1024	
1025	              esp32s3_endtransfer(priv,
1026	                                  SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1027	            }
1028	
1029	          /* Handle data end events.  Note that RXDR may accompany DTO, DTO
1030	           * will be set on received while there is still data in the FIFO.
1031	           * So for the case of receiving, we don't actually even enable the
1032	           * DTO interrupt.
1033	           */
1034	
1035	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_INT_DTO) != 0)
1036	            {
1037	              /* Finish the transfer */
1038	
1039	              esp32s3_endtransfer(priv, SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE);
1040	            }
1041	        }
1042	
1043	      /* Handle wait events *************************************************/
1044	
1045	      pending = enabled & priv->waitmask;
1046	      if (pending != 0)
1047	        {
1048	          /* Is this a response error event? */
1049	
1050	          if ((pending & SDCARD_INT_RESPERR) != 0)
1051	            {
1052	              /* If response errors are enabled, then we must certainly be
1053	               * waiting for a response.
1054	               */
1055	
1056	              DEBUGASSERT((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE) != 0);
1057	
1058	              /* Wake the thread up */
1059	
1060	              mcerr("ERROR: Response error, pending=%08x\n", pending);
1061	              esp32s3_endwait(priv, SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1062	            }
1063	
1064	          /* Is this a command (plus response) completion event? */
1065	
1066	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_INT_CDONE) != 0)
1067	            {
1068	              /* Yes.. Is their a thread waiting for response done? */
1069	
1070	              if ((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE) != 0)
1071	                {
1072	                  /* Yes.. wake the thread up */
1073	
1074	                  esp32s3_endwait(priv, SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE);
1075	                }
1076	
1077	              /* NO.. Is their a thread waiting for command done? */
1078	
1079	              else if ((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_CMDDONE) != 0)
1080	                {
1081	                  /* Yes.. wake the thread up */
1082	
1083	                  esp32s3_endwait(priv, SDIOWAIT_CMDDONE);
1084	                }
1085	            }
1086	        }
1087	    }
1088	
1089	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32S3_SDMMC_DMA
1090	  /* DMA error events *******************************************************/
1091	
1092	  pending = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_IDSTS);
1093	  if ((pending & priv->dmamask) != 0)
1094	    {
1095	      mcerr("ERROR: IDTS=%08lx\n", (unsigned long)pending);
1096	
1097	      /* Clear the pending interrupts */
1098	
1099	      esp32s3_putreg(pending, ESP32S3_SDMMC_IDSTS);
1100	
1101	      /* Abort the transfer */
1102	
1103	      esp32s3_endtransfer(priv, SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1104	    }
1105	#endif
1106	
1107	  return OK;
1108	}

1142	/****************************************************************************
1143	 * Name: esp32s3_reset
1144	 *
1145	 * Description:
1146	 *   Reset the SDIO controller.  Undo all setup and initialization.
1147	 *
1148	 * Input Parameters:
1149	 *   dev    - An instance of the SDIO device interface
1150	 *
1151	 * Returned Value:
1152	 *   None
1153	 *
1154	 ****************************************************************************/
1155	
1156	static void esp32s3_reset(struct sdio_dev_s *dev)
1157	{
1158	  struct esp32s3_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32s3_dev_s *)dev;
1159	  irqstate_t flags;
1160	  uint32_t regval;
1161	
1162	  mcinfo("Resetting...\n");
1163	
1164	  flags = enter_critical_section();
1165	
1166	  /* Reset all blocks */
1167	
1168	  esp32s3_putreg(SDMMC_CTRL_CNTLRRESET | SDMMC_CTRL_FIFORESET |
1169	                 SDMMC_CTRL_DMARESET, ESP32S3_SDMMC_CTRL);
1170	
1171	  while ((esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_CTRL) &
1172	         (SDMMC_CTRL_CNTLRRESET | SDMMC_CTRL_FIFORESET |
1173	          SDMMC_CTRL_DMARESET)) != 0)
1174	    {
1175	    }
1176	
1177	  /* Select clock source and init phases */
1178	
1179	  regval = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_CLOCK);
1180	  regval &= ~(SDMMC_CLOCK_CLK_SEL_MASK | SDMMC_CLOCK_PHASE_MASK);
1181	  regval |= SDMMC_CLOCK_CLK_SEL_PLL160M;
1182	  regval |= 1 << SDMMC_CLOCK_PHASE_DOUT_SHIFT;
1183	  esp32s3_putreg(regval, ESP32S3_SDMMC_CLOCK);
1184	
1185	  /* Select clock divider
1186	   * Slot N selects clock divider N.
1187	   */
1188	
1189	  regval = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_CLKSRC);
1190	  regval &= ~SDMMC_CLKSRC_MASK(priv->slot);
1191	  regval |= SDMMC_CLKSRC_CLKDIV(priv->slot, priv->slot);
1192	  esp32s3_putreg(regval, ESP32S3_SDMMC_CLKSRC);
1193	
1194	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32S3_SDMMC_DMA
1195	  esp32s3_putreg((uint32_t)&priv->dma_desc[0], ESP32S3_SDMMC_DBADDR);
1196	#endif
1197	
1198	  /* Reset data */
1199	
1200	  priv->waitevents = 0;      /* Set of events to be waited for */
1201	  priv->waitmask   = 0;      /* Interrupt enables for event waiting */
1202	  priv->wkupevent  = 0;      /* The event that caused the wakeup */
1203	
1204	  wd_cancel(&priv->waitwdog); /* Cancel any timeouts */
1205	
1206	  /* Interrupt mode data transfer support */
1207	
1208	  priv->buffer     = 0;      /* Address of current R/W buffer */
1209	  priv->remaining  = 0;      /* Number of bytes remaining in the transfer */
1210	  priv->xfrmask    = 0;      /* Interrupt enables for data transfer */
1211	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32S3_SDMMC_DMA
1212	  priv->dmamask    = 0;      /* Interrupt enables for DMA transfer */
1213	#endif
1214	
1215	  /* DMA data transfer support */
1216	
1217	  priv->cdstatus   = 0;      /* Card status is unknown */
1218	
1219	  leave_critical_section(flags);
1220	}

1331	static int sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(struct esp32s3_dev_s *priv)
1332	{
1333	  /* Clock update command
1334	   * not a real command; just updates CIU registers
1335	   */
1336	
1337	  uint32_t cmd = SDMMC_CMD_UPDCLOCK | SDMMC_CMD_WAITPREV |
1338	                 SDMMC_CMD_CARD_NUMBER(priv->slot);
1339	  uint32_t regval;
1340	  bool repeat = true;
1341	  int timeout_ms = 100;
1342	  int ret;
1343	
1344	  while (repeat)
1345	    {
1346	      ret = esp32s3_ciu_sendcmd(cmd, 0);
1347	      if (ret)
1348	        {
1349	          return ret;
1350	        }
1351	
1352	      while (timeout_ms)
1353	        {
1354	          regval = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS);
1355	          if (regval & SDMMC_INT_HLE)
1356	            {
1357	              esp32s3_putreg(SDMMC_INT_HLE, ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS);
1358	              break;
1359	            }
1360	
1361	          if ((esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_CMD) & SDMMC_CMD_STARTCMD)
1362	              == 0)
1363	            {
1364	              repeat = false;
1365	              break;
1366	            }
1367	
1368	          timeout_ms--;
1369	          up_mdelay(1);
1370	        }
1371	    }
1372	
1373	  return timeout_ms > 0 ? OK : -ETIMEDOUT;
1374	}

1376	static void sdmmc_host_get_clk_dividers(uint32_t freq_khz, int *host_div,
1377	                                        int *card_div)
1378	{
1379	  uint32_t clk_src_freq_hz = BOARD_SDMMC_FREQUENCY;
1380	
1381	  /* Calculate new dividers */
1382	
1383	  if (freq_khz >= 40 * 1000)
1384	    {
1385	      *host_div = 4;       /* 160 MHz / 4 = 40 MHz */
1386	      *card_div = 0;
1387	    }
1388	  else if (freq_khz == 20 * 1000)
1389	    {
1390	      *host_div = 8;       /* 160 MHz / 8 = 20 MHz */
1391	      *card_div = 0;
1392	    }
1393	  else if (freq_khz == 400)
1394	    {
1395	      *host_div = 10;      /* 160 MHz / 10 / (20 * 2) = 400 kHz */
1396	      *card_div = 20;
1397	    }
1398	  else
1399	    {
1400	      /* for custom frequencies use maximum range of host divider (1-16),
1401	       * find the closest <= div. combination
1402	       * if exceeded, combine with the card divider to keep reasonable
1403	       * precision (applies mainly to low frequencies)
1404	       * effective frequency range: 400 kHz - 32 MHz (32.1 - 39.9 MHz cannot
1405	       * be covered with given divider scheme)
1406	       */
1407	
1408	      *host_div = (clk_src_freq_hz) / (freq_khz * 1000);
1409	      if (*host_div > 15)
1410	        {
1411	          *host_div = 2;
1412	          *card_div = (clk_src_freq_hz / 2) / (2 * freq_khz * 1000);
1413	          if (((clk_src_freq_hz / 2) % (2 * freq_khz * 1000)) > 0)
1414	            {
1415	              (*card_div)++;
1416	            }
1417	        }
1418	      else if ((clk_src_freq_hz % (freq_khz * 1000)) > 0)
1419	        {
1420	          (*host_div)++;
1421	        }
1422	    }
1423	}

1425	static void sdmmc_host_set_clk_div(uint32_t slot, uint32_t host_div,
1426	                                   uint32_t card_div)
1427	{
1428	  irqstate_t flags = enter_critical_section();
1429	
1430	  /* Set frequency to 160MHz / div
1431	   *
1432	   * n: counter resets at div_factor_n.
1433	   * l: negedge when counter equals div_factor_l.
1434	   * h: posedge when counter equals div_factor_h.
1435	   *
1436	   * We set the duty cycle to 1/2
1437	   */
1438	
1439	  ASSERT(host_div > 1 && host_div <= 16);
1440	  int l = host_div - 1;
1441	  int h = host_div / 2 - 1;
1442	  uint32_t regval;
1443	  uint32_t divider;
1444	
1445	  /* Get the divider which is selected in esp32s3_reset() */
1446	
1447	  regval = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_CLKSRC);
1448	  divider = (regval & SDMMC_CLKSRC_MASK(slot)) >> SDMMC_CLKSRC_SHIFT(slot);
1449	
1450	  /* Set card divider */
1451	
1452	  regval = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_CLKDIV);
1453	  regval &= ~SDMMC_CLKDIV_MASK(divider);
1454	  regval |= SDMMC_CLKDIV(divider, card_div);
1455	  esp32s3_putreg(regval, ESP32S3_SDMMC_CLKDIV);
1456	
1457	  /* Set host_div divider */
1458	
1459	  regval = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_CLOCK);
1460	  regval &= ~SDMMC_CLOCK_DIV_FACTOR_MASK;
1461	  regval |= (h << SDMMC_CLOCK_DIV_FACTOR_H_SHIFT)
1462	            & SDMMC_CLOCK_DIV_FACTOR_H_MASK;
1463	  regval |= (l << SDMMC_CLOCK_DIV_FACTOR_L_SHIFT)
1464	            & SDMMC_CLOCK_DIV_FACTOR_L_MASK;
1465	  regval |= (l << SDMMC_CLOCK_DIV_FACTOR_N_SHIFT)
1466	            & SDMMC_CLOCK_DIV_FACTOR_N_MASK;
1467	  esp32s3_putreg(regval, ESP32S3_SDMMC_CLOCK);
1468	
1469	  leave_critical_section(flags);
1470	
1471	  /* Wait for the clock to propagate */
1472	
1473	  up_udelay(10);
1474	}

1476	/****************************************************************************
1477	 * Name: esp32s3_clock
1478	 *
1479	 * Description:
1480	 *   Enable/disable SDIO clocking
1481	 *
1482	 * Input Parameters:
1483	 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
1484	 *   rate - Specifies the clocking to use (see enum sdio_clock_e)
1485	 *
1486	 * Returned Value:
1487	 *   None
1488	 *
1489	 ****************************************************************************/
1490	
1491	static void esp32s3_clock(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, enum sdio_clock_e rate)
1492	{
1493	  uint32_t freq_khz;
1494	  uint32_t regval;
1495	  bool clk_en = true;
1496	  int host_div = 0;   /* clock divider of the host (SDMMC.clock) */
1497	  int card_div = 0;   /* 1/2 of card clock divider (SDMMC.clkdiv) */
1498	  struct esp32s3_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32s3_dev_s *)dev;
1499	
1500	  switch (rate)
1501	    {
1502	      /* Disable clocking (with default ID mode divisor) */
1503	
1504	      default:
1505	      case CLOCK_SDIO_DISABLED:
1506	        freq_khz = 400;
1507	        clk_en = false;
1508	        break;
1509	
1510	      /* Enable in initial ID mode clocking (<400KHz) */
1511	
1512	      case CLOCK_IDMODE:
1513	        freq_khz = 400;
1514	        break;
1515	
1516	      /* Enable in MMC normal operation clocking */
1517	
1518	      case CLOCK_MMC_TRANSFER:
1519	        if (esp32s3_capabilities(dev) & SDIO_CAPS_MMC_HS_MODE)
1520	          {
1521	            freq_khz = 40 * 1000;
1522	          }
1523	        else
1524	          {
1525	            freq_khz = 20 * 1000;
1526	          }
1527	        break;
1528	
1529	      /* SD normal operation clocking (wide 4-bit mode) */
1530	
1531	      case CLOCK_SD_TRANSFER_4BIT:
1532	#ifndef CONFIG_ESP32S3_SDMMC_WIDTH_D1_ONLY
1533	        /* TODO: Use higher frequency */
1534	
1535	        freq_khz = 20 * 1000;
1536	        esp32s3_widebus(dev, true);
1537	        break;
1538	#endif
1539	
1540	      /* SD normal operation clocking (narrow 1-bit mode) */
1541	
1542	      case CLOCK_SD_TRANSFER_1BIT:
1543	
1544	        /* TODO: Use higher frequency */
1545	
1546	        freq_khz = 20 * 1000;
1547	        esp32s3_widebus(dev, false);
1548	        break;
1549	    }
1550	
1551	  /* Disable clock first */
1552	
1553	  regval = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_CLKENA);
1554	  regval &= ~(SDMMC_CLKENA_ENABLE(priv->slot)
1555	              | SDMMC_CLKENA_LOWPOWER(priv->slot));
1556	  esp32s3_putreg(regval, ESP32S3_SDMMC_CLKENA);
1557	  if (sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(priv) != OK)
1558	  {
1559	    mcerr("disabling clk failed\n");
1560	    return;
1561	  }
1562	
1563	  /* Program card clock settings, send them to the CIU */
1564	
1565	  sdmmc_host_get_clk_dividers(freq_khz, &host_div, &card_div);
1566	  sdmmc_host_set_clk_div(priv->slot, host_div, card_div);
1567	  if (sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(priv) != OK)
1568	  {
1569	    mcerr("setting clk div failed\n");
1570	    return;
1571	  }
1572	
1573	  /* Re-enable clocks */
1574	
1575	  if (clk_en)
1576	    {
1577	      regval = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_CLKENA);
1578	      regval |= SDMMC_CLKENA_ENABLE(priv->slot)
1579	                | SDMMC_CLKENA_LOWPOWER(priv->slot);
1580	      esp32s3_putreg(regval, ESP32S3_SDMMC_CLKENA);
1581	      if (sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(priv) != OK)
1582	        {
1583	          mcerr("re-enabling clk failed\n");
1584	          return;
1585	        }
1586	    }
1587	
1588	  /* set data timeout to 100ms */
1589	
1590	  if (freq_khz * 100 > (SDMMC_TMOUT_DATA_MASK >> SDMMC_TMOUT_DATA_SHIFT))
1591	    {
1592	      regval = SDMMC_TMOUT_DATA_MASK;
1593	    }
1594	  else
1595	    {
1596	      regval = freq_khz * 100 << SDMMC_TMOUT_DATA_SHIFT;
1597	    }
1598	
1599	  /* always set response timeout to highest value, it's small enough anyway */
1600	
1601	  regval |= SDMMC_TMOUT_RESPONSE_MASK;
1602	  esp32s3_putreg(regval, ESP32S3_SDMMC_TMOUT);
1603	}

1653	       */

1655	      up_enable_irq(ESP32S3_IRQ_SDIO_HOST);
1656	    }
1657

1661	/****************************************************************************
1662	 * Name: esp32s3_sendcmd
1663	 *
1664	 * Description:
1665	 *   Send the SDIO command
1666	 *
1667	 * Input Parameters:
1668	 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
1669	 *   cmd  - The command to send (32-bits, encoded)
1670	 *   arg  - 32-bit argument required with some commands
1671	 *
1672	 * Returned Value:
1673	 *   None
1674	 *
1675	 ****************************************************************************/
1676	
1677	static int esp32s3_sendcmd(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, uint32_t cmd,
1678	                           uint32_t arg)
1679	{
1680	  struct esp32s3_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32s3_dev_s *)dev;
1681	  uint32_t regval = 0;
1682	
1683	  mcinfo("cmd=%04x arg=%04x\n", cmd, arg);
1684	
1685	  if (cmd == MMCSD_CMD12)
1686	    {
1687	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_STOPABORT;
1688	    }
1689	  else if (cmd == MMCSD_CMD0)
1690	    {
1691	      /* The CMD0 needs the SENDINIT CMD */
1692	
1693	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_SENDINIT;
1694	    }
1695	  else
1696	    {
1697	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_WAITPREV;
1698	    }
1699	
1700	  /* Is this a Read/Write Transfer Command ? */
1701	
1702	  if ((cmd & MMCSD_WRDATAXFR) == MMCSD_WRDATAXFR)
1703	    {
1704	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_DATAXFREXPTD | SDMMC_CMD_WRITE;
1705	    }
1706	  else if ((cmd & MMCSD_RDDATAXFR) == MMCSD_RDDATAXFR)
1707	    {
1708	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_DATAXFREXPTD;
1709	    }
1710	
1711	  /* Set WAITRESP bits */
1712	
1713	  switch (cmd & MMCSD_RESPONSE_MASK)
1714	    {
1715	    case MMCSD_NO_RESPONSE:
1716	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_NORESPONSE;
1717	      break;
1718	
1719	    case MMCSD_R1B_RESPONSE:
1720	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_RESPCRC;
1721	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_WAITPREV;
1722	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_SHORTRESPONSE;
1723	      break;
1724	
1725	    case MMCSD_R3_RESPONSE:
1726	    case MMCSD_R4_RESPONSE:
1727	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_SHORTRESPONSE;
1728	      break;
1729	
1730	    case MMCSD_R1_RESPONSE:
1731	    case MMCSD_R5_RESPONSE:
1732	    case MMCSD_R6_RESPONSE:
1733	    case MMCSD_R7_RESPONSE:
1734	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_RESPCRC;
1735	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_SHORTRESPONSE;
1736	      break;
1737	
1738	    case MMCSD_R2_RESPONSE:
1739	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_LONGRESPONSE;
1740	      regval |= SDMMC_CMD_RESPCRC;
1741	      break;
1742	    }
1743	
1744	  /* Set the command index */
1745	
1746	  regval |= (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) >> MMCSD_CMDIDX_SHIFT;
1747	  regval |= SDMMC_CMD_CARD_NUMBER(priv->slot);
1748	
1749	  /* Write the SD card CMD */
1750	
1751	  esp32s3_ciu_sendcmd(regval, arg);
1752	
1753	  return OK;
1754	}

1784	 * Name: esp32s3_recvsetup
1785	 *
1786	 * Description:
1787	 *   Setup hardware in preparation for data transfer from the card in non-DMA
1788	 *   (interrupt driven mode).  This method will do whatever controller setup
1789	 *   is necessary.  This would be called for SD memory just BEFORE sending
1790	 *   CMD13 (SEND_STATUS), CMD17 (READ_SINGLE_BLOCK), CMD18
1791	 *   (READ_MULTIPLE_BLOCKS), ACMD51 (SEND_SCR), etc.  Normally,
1792	 *   SDIO_WAITEVENT will be called to receive the indication that the
1793	 *   transfer is complete.
1794	 *
1795	 * Input Parameters:
1796	 *   dev    - An instance of the SDIO device interface
1797	 *   buffer - Address of the buffer in which to receive the data
1798	 *   nbytes - The number of bytes in the transfer
1799	 *
1800	 * Returned Value:
1801	 *   Number of bytes sent on success; a negated errno on failure
1802	 *
1803	 ****************************************************************************/
1804	
1805	static int esp32s3_recvsetup(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, uint8_t *buffer,
1806	                             size_t nbytes)
1807	{
1808	  struct esp32s3_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32s3_dev_s *)dev;
1809	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32S3_SDMMC_DMA
1810	  uint32_t regval;
1811	#endif
1812	
1813	  mcinfo("nbytes=%ld\n", (long) nbytes);
1814	
1815	  DEBUGASSERT(priv != NULL && buffer != NULL && nbytes > 0);
1816	  DEBUGASSERT(((uint32_t)buffer & 3) == 0);
1817	
1818	  /* Save the destination buffer information for use by the interrupt
1819	   * handler.
1820	   */
1821	
1822	  priv->buffer    = (uint32_t *)buffer;
1823	  priv->remaining = nbytes;
1824	  priv->wrdir     = false;
1825	
1826	  /* Configure the FIFO so that we will receive the RXDR interrupt whenever
1827	   * there are more than 1 words (at least 8 bytes) in the RX FIFO.
1828	   */
1829	
1830	  esp32s3_putreg(SDMMC_FIFOTH_RXWMARK(1), ESP32S3_SDMMC_FIFOTH);
1831	
1832	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32S3_SDMMC_DMA
1833	  /* Make sure that internal DMA is disabled */
1834	
1835	  esp32s3_putreg(0, ESP32S3_SDMMC_BMOD);
1836	
1837	  regval  = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_CTRL);
1838	  regval &= ~SDMMC_CTRL_INTDMA;
1839	  esp32s3_putreg(regval, ESP32S3_SDMMC_CTRL);
1840	#endif
1841	
1842	  /* Flush ints before we start */
1843	
1844	  esp32s3_putreg(SDCARD_TRANSFER_ALL, ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS);
1845	
1846	  /* Configure the transfer interrupts */
1847	
1848	  esp32s3_config_xfrints(priv, SDCARD_RECV_MASK);
1849	  return OK;
1850	}

1852	/****************************************************************************
1853	 * Name: esp32s3_sendsetup
1854	 *
1855	 * Description:

1968	/****************************************************************************
1969	 * Name: esp32s3_waitresponse
1970	 *
1971	 * Description:
1972	 *   Poll-wait for the response to the last command to be ready.
1973	 *
1974	 * Input Parameters:
1975	 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
1976	 *   cmd  - The command that was sent.  See 32-bit command definitions above.
1977	 *
1978	 * Returned Value:
1979	 *   OK is success; a negated errno on failure
1980	 *
1981	 ****************************************************************************/
1982	
1983	static int esp32s3_waitresponse(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, uint32_t cmd)
1984	{
1985	  int ret = OK;
1986	  volatile int32_t timeout;
1987	  clock_t watchtime;
1988	
1989	  mcinfo("cmd=%04x\n", cmd);
1990	
1991	  switch (cmd & MMCSD_RESPONSE_MASK)
1992	    {
1993	    case MMCSD_NO_RESPONSE:
1994	    case MMCSD_R3_RESPONSE:
1995	    case MMCSD_R7_RESPONSE:
1996	      timeout = SDCARD_CMDTIMEOUT;
1997	      break;
1998	
1999	    case MMCSD_R1_RESPONSE:
2000	    case MMCSD_R1B_RESPONSE:
2001	    case MMCSD_R2_RESPONSE:
2002	    case MMCSD_R4_RESPONSE:
2003	    case MMCSD_R5_RESPONSE:
2004	    case MMCSD_R6_RESPONSE:
2005	      timeout = SDCARD_LONGTIMEOUT;
2006	      break;
2007	
2008	    default:
2009	      return -EINVAL;
2010	    }
2011	
2012	  watchtime = clock_systime_ticks();
2013	
2014	  /* We should wait for CMDDONE, even if there is a response error. */
2015	
2016	  while ((esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS) & SDMMC_INT_CDONE) == 0)
2017	    {
2018	      if (clock_systime_ticks() - watchtime > timeout)
2019	        {
2020	          mcerr("ERROR: Timeout cmd: %04x STA: %08x RINTSTS: %08x\n",
2021	                cmd, esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_STATUS),
2022	                esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS));
2023	
2024	          ret = -ETIMEDOUT;
2025	        }
2026	    }
2027	
2028	  /* Check if there is a response error. */
2029	
2030	  if (esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS) & SDCARD_INT_RESPERR)
2031	    {
2032	      mcerr("ERROR: SDMMC failure cmd: %04x STA: %08x RINTSTS: %08x\n",
2033	            cmd, esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_STATUS),
2034	            esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS));
2035	      ret = -EIO;
2036	    }
2037	
2038	  esp32s3_putreg(SDCARD_CMDDONE_CLEAR, ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS);
2039	  return ret;
2040	}

2043	 * Name: esp32s3_recvshortcrc
2044	 *
2045	 * Description:
2046	 *   Receive response to SDIO command.  Only the critical payload is
2047	 *   returned -- 32 bits for 48 bit status.  The driver implementation
2048	 *   verifies the correctness of the remaining, non-returned bits (CRCs, CMD
2049	 *   index, etc.).
2050	 *
2051	 * Input Parameters:
2052	 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
2053	 *   Rx   - Buffer in which to receive the response
2054	 *
2055	 * Returned Value:
2056	 *   Number of bytes sent on success; a negated errno on failure.  Here a
2057	 *   failure means only a faiure to obtain the requested response (due to
2058	 *   transport problem -- timeout, CRC, etc.).  The implementation only
2059	 *   assures that the response is returned intacta and does not check errors
2060	 *   within the response itself.
2061	 *
2062	 ****************************************************************************/
2063	
2064	static int esp32s3_recvshortcrc(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, uint32_t cmd,
2065	                                uint32_t *rshort)
2066	{
2067	  uint32_t regval;
2068	  int ret = OK;
2069	
2070	  mcinfo("cmd=%04x\n", cmd);
2071	
2072	  /* R1  Command response (48-bit)
2073	   *     47        0               Start bit
2074	   *     46        0               Transmission bit (0=from card)
2075	   *     45:40     bit5   - bit0   Command index (0-63)
2076	   *     39:8      bit31  - bit0   32-bit card status
2077	   *     7:1       bit6   - bit0   CRC7
2078	   *     0         1               End bit
2079	   *
2080	   * R1b Identical to R1 with the additional busy signaling via the data
2081	   *     line.
2082	   *
2083	   * R6  Published RCA Response (48-bit, SD card only)
2084	   *     47        0               Start bit
2085	   *     46        0               Transmission bit (0=from card)
2086	   *     45:40     bit5   - bit0   Command index (0-63)
2087	   *     39:8      bit31  - bit0   32-bit Argument Field, consisting of:
2088	   *                               [31:16] New published RCA of card
2089	   *                               [15:0]  Card status bits {23,22,19,12:0}
2090	   *     7:1       bit6   - bit0   CRC7
2091	   *     0         1               End bit
2092	   */
2093	
2094	#ifdef CONFIG_DEBUG_FEATURES
2095	  if (!rshort)
2096	    {
2097	      mcerr("ERROR: rshort=NULL\n");
2098	      ret = -EINVAL;
2099	    }
2100	
2101	  /* Check that this is the correct response to this command */
2102	
2103	  else if ((cmd & MMCSD_RESPONSE_MASK) != MMCSD_R1_RESPONSE &&
2104	           (cmd & MMCSD_RESPONSE_MASK) != MMCSD_R1B_RESPONSE &&
2105	           (cmd & MMCSD_RESPONSE_MASK) != MMCSD_R6_RESPONSE)
2106	    {
2107	      mcerr("ERROR: Wrong response CMD=%04x\n", cmd);
2108	      ret = -EINVAL;
2109	    }
2110	  else
2111	#endif
2112	    {
2113	      /* Check if a timeout or CRC error occurred */
2114	
2115	      regval = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS);
2116	      if ((regval & SDMMC_INT_RTO) != 0)
2117	        {
2118	          mcerr("ERROR: Command timeout: %08x\n", regval);
2119	          ret = -ETIMEDOUT;
2120	        }
2121	      else if ((regval & SDMMC_INT_RCRC) != 0)
2122	        {
2123	          mcerr("ERROR: CRC failure: %08x\n", regval);
2124	          ret = -EIO;
2125	        }
2126	    }
2127	
2128	  /* Clear all pending message completion events and return the R1/R6
2129	   * response.
2130	   */
2131	
2132	  esp32s3_putreg(SDCARD_RESPDONE_CLEAR | SDCARD_CMDDONE_CLEAR,
2133	                 ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS);
2134	  *rshort = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_RESP0);
2135	  mcinfo("CRC=%04x\n", *rshort);
2136	
2137	  return ret;
2138	}

2293	/****************************************************************************
2294	 * Name: esp32s3_waitenable
2295	 *
2296	 * Description:
2297	 *   Enable/disable of a set of SDIO wait events.  This is part of the
2298	 *   the SDIO_WAITEVENT sequence.  The set of to-be-waited-for events is
2299	 *   configured before calling esp32s3_eventwait.  This is done in this way
2300	 *   to help the driver to eliminate race conditions between the command
2301	 *   setup and the subsequent events.
2302	 *
2303	 *   The enabled events persist until either (1) SDIO_WAITENABLE is called
2304	 *   again specifying a different set of wait events, or (2) SDIO_EVENTWAIT
2305	 *   returns.
2306	 *
2307	 * Input Parameters:
2308	 *   dev      - An instance of the SDIO device interface
2309	 *   eventset - A bitset of events to enable or disable (see SDIOWAIT_*
2310	 *              definitions). 0=disable; 1=enable.
2311	 *
2312	 * Returned Value:
2313	 *   None
2314	 *
2315	 ****************************************************************************/
2316	
2317	static void esp32s3_waitenable(struct sdio_dev_s *dev,
2318	                               sdio_eventset_t eventset, uint32_t timeout)
2319	{
2320	  struct esp32s3_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32s3_dev_s *)dev;
2321	  uint32_t waitmask;
2322	
2323	  mcinfo("eventset=%04x\n", (unsigned int)eventset);
2324	  DEBUGASSERT(priv != NULL);
2325	
2326	  /* Disable event-related interrupts */
2327	
2328	  esp32s3_config_waitints(priv, 0, 0, 0);
2329	
2330	  /* Select the interrupt mask that will give us the appropriate wakeup
2331	   * interrupts.
2332	   */
2333	
2334	  waitmask = 0;
2335	  if ((eventset & SDIOWAIT_CMDDONE) != 0)
2336	    {
2337	      waitmask |= SDCARD_CMDDONE_MASK;
2338	    }
2339	
2340	  if ((eventset & SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE) != 0)
2341	    {
2342	      waitmask |= SDCARD_RESPDONE_MASK;
2343	    }
2344	
2345	  if ((eventset & SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE) != 0)
2346	    {
2347	      waitmask |= SDCARD_XFRDONE_MASK;
2348	    }
2349	
2350	  /* Enable event-related interrupts */
2351	
2352	  esp32s3_config_waitints(priv, waitmask, eventset, 0);
2353	
2354	  /* Check if the timeout event is specified in the event set */
2355	
2356	  if ((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT) != 0)
2357	    {
2358	      int delay;
2359	      int ret;
2360	
2361	      /* Yes.. Handle a cornercase: The user request a timeout event but
2362	       * with timeout == 0?
2363	       */
2364	
2365	      if (!timeout)
2366	        {
2367	          priv->wkupevent = SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT;
2368	          return;
2369	        }
2370	
2371	      /* Start the watchdog timer */
2372	
2373	      delay = MSEC2TICK(timeout);
2374	      ret   = wd_start(&priv->waitwdog, delay,
2375	                       esp32s3_eventtimeout, (wdparm_t)priv);
2376	      if (ret < 0)

2383	/****************************************************************************
2384	 * Name: esp32s3_eventwait
2385	 *
2386	 * Description:
2387	 *   Wait for one of the enabled events to occur (or a timeout).  Note that
2388	 *   all events enabled by SDIO_WAITEVENTS are disabled when
2389	 *   esp32s3_eventwait returns.  SDIO_WAITEVENTS must be called again before
2390	 *   esp32s3_eventwait can be used again.
2391	 *
2392	 * Input Parameters:
2393	 *   dev     - An instance of the SDIO device interface
2394	 *   timeout - Maximum time in milliseconds to wait.  Zero means immediate
2395	 *             timeout with no wait.  The timeout value is ignored if
2396	 *             SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT is not included in the waited-for eventset.
2397	 *
2398	 * Returned Value:
2399	 *   Event set containing the event(s) that ended the wait.  Should always
2400	 *   be non-zero.  All events are disabled after the wait concludes.
2401	 *
2402	 ****************************************************************************/
2403	
2404	static sdio_eventset_t esp32s3_eventwait(struct sdio_dev_s *dev)
2405	{
2406	  struct esp32s3_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32s3_dev_s *)dev;
2407	  sdio_eventset_t wkupevent = 0;
2408	  irqstate_t flags;
2409	  int ret;
2410	
2411	  /* There is a race condition here... the event may have completed before
2412	   * we get here.  In this case waitevents will be zero, but wkupevents will
2413	   * be non-zero (and, hopefully, the semaphore count will also be non-zero.
2414	   */
2415	
2416	  flags = enter_critical_section();
2417	  DEBUGASSERT(priv->waitevents != 0 || priv->wkupevent != 0);
2418	
2419	  /* Loop until the event (or the timeout occurs). Race conditions are
2420	   * avoided by calling esp32s3_waitenable prior to triggering the logic that
2421	   * will cause the wait to terminate.  Under certain race conditions, the
2422	   * waited-for may have already occurred before this function was called!
2423	   */
2424	
2425	  for (; ; )
2426	    {
2427	      /* Wait for an event in event set to occur.  If this the event has
2428	       * already occurred, then the semaphore will already have been
2429	       * incremented and there will be no wait.
2430	       */
2431	
2432	      ret = nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&priv->waitsem);
2433	      if (ret < 0)
2434	        {
2435	          /* Task canceled.  Cancel the wdog -- assuming it was started and
2436	           * return an SDIO error.
2437	           */
2438	
2439	          wd_cancel(&priv->waitwdog);
2440	          wkupevent = SDIOWAIT_ERROR;
2441	          goto out;
2442	        }
2443	
2444	      wkupevent = priv->wkupevent;
